_comment: Tier-2 for febio::hyperelasticity#4. Two decks differing only in <step_size> (10 x 1.0 and 10 x 0.1) both reach normal termination with exit 0 and both report 10 completed steps — the fixture asserts that equality, because it is what makes the step count useless as a check — while the last *Time in the logfile CSV is 10 for the first and 1 for the second. Both final times are required to equal time_steps x step_size. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
